summary: The audit counts your courses toward the 60 units the major needs. Every core course (gateway, comparative core, major core, methodology, international dimension, community-engaged learning, WIM and capstone) must be taken for a letter grade, unless only offered S/NC, with a C- or better; methodology courses need 3 or more units. The rest of the 60 units are ASNAMST electives, plus at most 8 units of AFRICAAM, CHILATST, CSRE, JEWISHST or NATIVEAM courses and 5 units of Asian language. Petitioned courses (at most 15 units), external credit (at most 20 units) and a CEL fellowship or Alternative Spring Break are moved in by hand. Left: you may count only 2 electives taken S/NC, which the audit does not limit. Honors requires CSRE 201X-Z, a B+ thesis and the GPA minimums.
